verdict.rationale: Dev handoff is a fair question for a design tool like Spline. However, the evidence pack documents no inspect mode for a developer without an editor seat that shows per-layer measurements, styles, assets, or CSS/iOS/Android code snippets. The documented scene code export (Vanilla JS, React, etc.), the Code API and self-hosted ZIP export are adjacent features for embedding whole scenes, not layer-level handoff inspection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
